'''2011 Worlds Day 2 John Anderson LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''YIELD'''; username Puck71. Handwritten. Line 6 HFTMF → Heading For The Medical Frigate; lines 21–24 '''Yub Yub Commander''' → Yub Yub!; line 29 '''Biggs Rogue Legend''' → Biggs Darklighter; lines 31–33 '''Veteran Rogue''' → Veteran Attacker; line 40 '''Luke's L.S.''' → Luke's Lightsaber (V); line 52 '''Commands Training & Worship''' → Commando Training & Klor'slug; line 56 OOC+TT → Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Center Of Tyranny]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
